items.html: *Know that at first, during the pregnancy, ZA had only the aspect of Nefesh alone in him, which is his Malchut and his six extremities. And when he was born, the Ruach came to him and was completed to the six extremities during the days of nursing. But the Nukva, before the time of the pregnancy, had in her only the point of Nefesh within Nefesh, Malchut within Malchut of hers, and her measure is the Atara in the Yesod of ZA, which is from his Nefesh.
